    df_numeric = df[numeric_cols].astype(common_type)

    res = df.copy()
    res[numeric_cols] = df_scaled

def calculate_station_metrics(df):

    df['precipitation'] = df['precipitation'].fillna(0.0)
    sums = {col: v.sum() for (col, v) in df.items()}

    return sums
